chronos_bolt_small.rule: within 1 % relative on MASE and WQL
chronos_bolt_small.verdict: forecasts reproduced; one MASE value not

investigation.finding: monash_hospital: our WQL equals the published WQL (0.05812 vs 0.05812), so the forecasts match; our MASE is 0.80083 against the published 0.69545 (15 % higher). exchange_rate matches on both (0.13 % and 0.32 %).
ruled_out: GluonTS version: 0.16.3 (the repository's pin ~=0.16) gives the same 0.80083 (ours_gluonts016_monash_hospital.csv); 0.17.0 was used for the main run
the seasonal period: the script derives 'M' and GluonTS gives 12; recomputing our forecasts' MASE by hand gives 0.80083 with season 12 and 0.92482 with season 1, neither 0.695
investigation.not_found: the cause of the published MASE; it may come from an older pandas or GluonTS in the authors' environment, which their repository does not record
investigation.consequence_for_rq1: RQ1 scores MAE, RMSE and MAPE on point forecasts, not MASE; the matching WQL shows the model and its forecasts reproduce
